purpose: Defines the standard record shape and the MapsTo token vocabulary that links each standard to the form fields it feeds. The review instrument renders from ACTIVE + (DRAFT-VALIDATE badged) standards filtered to Specialty in {Universal, case.RequiredReviewerSpecialty}.

standardRecord.StandardID: Category-prefixed: DOC-, CC-, MED-, BLD-, CON-, COM-, PK-, SYS-, MSR-, DBR-, or specialty-prefixed PC-GMO-, EM-, ORTHO-, MH-, PT-
standardRecord.aggregation: Per standard: rate = MET / (MET + NOT_MET). NA excluded from both numerator and denominator. Rates computed per provider, per specialty, and MEF-wide for the cross-specialty dashboard.

mapsToTokens.FPPE-3E: FPPE Template Section 3.E — Appropriate medication use (Y/N/NA)
mapsToTokens.FPPE-3F: FPPE Template Section 3.F — Broad scope of treatments reviewed
mapsToTokens.FPPE-3I: FPPE Template Section 3.I — % incomplete notes >3 business days
mapsToTokens.FPPE-3J: FPPE Template Section 3.J — Appropriate blood/blood components use
mapsToTokens.FPPE-3L: FPPE Template Section 3.L — # record reviews NOT within standard of care
mapsToTokens.FPPE-4-PC: FPPE Template Section 4 — Patient Care domain
mapsToTokens.FPPE-4-PK: FPPE Template Section 4 — Professional Knowledge domain
mapsToTokens.FPPE-4-PBLI: FPPE Template Section 4 — Practice Based Learning & Improvement domain
mapsToTokens.FPPE-4-ICS: FPPE Template Section 4 — Interpersonal & Communication Skills domain
mapsToTokens.OPPE-IIIF: OPPE Template Section III.F — % incomplete notes >3 business days
mapsToTokens.OPPE-IVD: OPPE Template Section IV.D — Appropriate blood/blood components use
mapsToTokens.OPPE-IVE: OPPE Template Section IV.E — Appropriate medication use
mapsToTokens.OPPE-IVF: OPPE Template Section IV.F — Medical record pertinence review
mapsToTokens.OPPE-IVG: OPPE Template Section IV.G — Medical record OPPE review (# reviewed)
mapsToTokens.OPPE-IVH: OPPE Template Section IV.H — Medical record OPPE review (# deficient)
mapsToTokens.OPPE-V: OPPE Template Section V — Specialty specific quality indicator (min 2 per OPPE)
mapsToTokens.455-I11: DHA 455 item 11 ratio/Y-N element block (element key appended, e.g. 455-I11:medication)
mapsToTokens.DASH-ONLY: Cross-specialty dashboard only; no form field

fixedInstrument.note: Form-mandated elements that render on EVERY case regardless of standards library content, captured in eCAF_ReviewSummaries: the DHA 455 item 11 element set (Item11Elements JSON) and the 16 competency constructs across six domains (CompetencyDomains JSON), plus OverallDetermination (Satisfactory/Unsatisfactory). The standards library ADDS specialty and rule-based depth; it never replaces the fixed instrument.
